description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First saw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Produce custom chainsaw on demand" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerProperties" name="Customer provides at least five chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce first saw and send updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble parts to produce the first saw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular production updates" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" name="Production and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first saw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" name="Does the customer like the first saw?" default="Flow_CustomerDoesNotLike"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingOrder" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderComplete" name="Rest of order produced"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDoesNotLike" name="Customer does not like the first saw"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_ReceiveParts" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveParts_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_ProductionSplit" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Assemble" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_Join" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_SendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSaw_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_LikesGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerLikes" name="Likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerLikesFirstSaw = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerDoesNotLike" name="Does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDoesNotLike"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRemaining_End" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineSources" name="Online parts sources"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsOrder" name="Parts order" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Participant_OnlineSources" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Parts" name="Parts" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineSources" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="First saw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
